preregistered_formula_family.rule: y_t = y_t-1 +/- max(1, abs(y_t-1)*1e-9); sign chosen from the last four prior same-series growth rates by the declared cycle-turning rules

formula_search.selection_scope: per target row; same-series years strictly earlier than heldout_year
formula_search.selection_metric: mean absolute residual on prior one-step replay rows with declared cycle-guard override

materiality_policy.metric: absolute residual advantage over best preregistered comparator

row_gate.uncertainty_upper: row selected-formula prior replay uncertainty interval upper bound

materiality_policy.near_tie_policy: a strict comparator residual greater-than is insufficient; grand support requires both aggregate and every row-level best-comparator margin to meet the preregistered materiality thresholds

policy.metric: absolute residual advantage over best preregistered comparator

row_gate.uncertainty_upper: row selected-formula prior replay uncertainty interval upper bound

policy.near_tie_policy: a strict comparator residual greater-than is insufficient; grand support requires both aggregate and every row-level best-comparator margin to meet the preregistered materiality thresholds

tamper_tests.description: mutating sampled heldout target values must change the canonical payload hash
mutating sampled heldout target values must change recomputed row hashes
mutating heldout targets must not change same-row selected formulas or predictions
mutating candidate-pack content must change the candidate-pack hash
